working_tree_dirty_reason: the bundle directory itself was untracked at export time; a review bundle is written after the experiment it describes. No tracked file was modified and no commit was amended; the tree's tracked content matched the tested commit exactly.

synthetic_origin.agent: scripts/fake-agent.mjs, a deterministic stand-in, not a language model
synthetic_origin.reason: the purpose is to exercise the producer-consumer contract between evaluateTrial(), evidence assembly and the candidate builder. No model call is made, no agent trajectory exists, and nothing here is an observed LLM action.
synthetic_origin.populated_fields_that_resemble_real_runs: records/construction-report.json carries proposer_harness_identity and a credential reference; these are produced by the same code paths as a real run and must not be read as evidence of an LLM execution.
